[42036 Cybersecurity for Mobile Platforms | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

This subject delves into the security risks and emerging threats associated with modern mobile devices and their operating systems. You'll explore platform security models, beginning with an introduction to the Android Studio simulation environment. The subject covers mobile platform security, encryption and decryption of messages, and mobile hardware security. You'll examine enterprise security extensions and conduct SQL mobile data injection, enhancing your understanding of data vulnerabilities. The subject also includes a comprehensive study of iOS security, covering hardware, system, application, service, and network security. Through practice-based learning, including secure data handling using AES and digital signatures, you will gain hands-on experience. The subject concludes with a review and recap of cybersecurity for mobile platforms, ensuring a well-rounded understanding of the field.

[42036 Cybersecurity for Mobile Platforms | Learning and teaching activities]
Cybersecurity for Mobile Platforms is designed to provide students with active and interactive learning opportunities. Students will engage in various settings, including classes, labs, and workshops. Students are expected to complete reading and viewing materials before each class and each lab. The pre-work materials will be used in classes and labs to help students complete lab tasks and actively engage in them. Feedback will be communicated each week verbally during the completion of lab and class tasks.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[42036 Cybersecurity for Mobile Platforms | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Analyse the current cybersecurity issues and challenges for the development of security solutions in mobile platforms. (B.1)
SLO2: Apply practical security tools and technologies to design appropriate solutions for specific mobile platforms. (C.1)
SLO3: Examine security risks to prevent fraud from mobile systems, services and applications. (D.1)
